svg.text: Flow 15 Adding, editing and removing raw materials (Admin)
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
• Only an Admin sees + Add raw material, Edit and Remove item; the API refuses them from Staff
• The unit (g, ml or pc) is fixed once the raw material is created, because recipes and the movement log are
written in it; stock itself changes only through Adjust (Flow 07).
• The form has the name, category, unit and opening stock (new only), minimum level and cost per unit, and In use
when editing. Unticking In use keeps the raw material and its history but stops it being added to new recipes;
saving a recipe that uses it puts it back in use.
• Removing deletes the raw material's stock movements and low-stock alerts with it. A raw material in a recipe
can't be removed, checked in the form, by the server and by the database (RESTRICT on recipe items).
